isitan-4r-hms.name: 4R HMS hydraulic 4-roll plate rollers
isitan-4r-hms.summary: İşitan's main line of 4-roll plate rolling machines, from a 2.1 ft bench-size roll to 10.2 ft machines that roll 3/8″ plate. The pinch roll and both side rolls move on a pyramid-style linear path driven by hydraulic cylinders, while the top roll is powered by an electric motor through a planetary gearbox — so the sheet is pinched, pre-bent at both ends and rolled into a full cylinder without being removed from the machine. Cone bending, hydraulic drop-end and three digital readouts are standard; NC control with programmed roll positions, overhead crane and side supports turn it into a semi- or fully automatic production line.
features: Pinch and side rolls moved linearly by hydraulic cylinders; top roll driven by motor and planetary gearbox, bottom roll through a cardan joint
Three digital readouts for easy roll positioning; mobile control panel
Hydraulic drop-end for easy removal of finished cylinders; hydraulic balancing system
Induction-hardened forged or rolled SAE 1050 (CK45) steel rolls; welded steel frames
Cone-bending device and overload protection standard
Remote technical support via Wi-Fi; built to EC safety directives (CE marked)
optional: NC control with remote assistance — teach mode, stored programs, 4 axes expandable to 7
Overhead crane and hydraulic side supports for large diameters
Vacuum sheet feeder and part ejector for full automation
Ground and polished rolls; two-speed or infinitely variable speed; hydraulic motor for rotation
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor

isitan-4r-corrugated.summary: Purpose-built 4-roll machines for corrugated galvanized sheet up to 11 ga — the material of tanks, roofs and silos. isitan-mrm-h.name: MRM-H hydraulic asymmetrical 3-roll plate rollers
isitan-mrm-h.summary: Initial-pinch 3-roll plate rolls with hydraulic movement of the back and bottom rolls and motor-driven rolls through planetary gearboxes — the hydraulic version of the MRM-S. The sheet is pinched between the top and bottom roll, pre-bent against the back roll, then rolled; the back roll runs on ball bearings for thin-sheet work and a hydraulic drop-end releases the finished cylinder. Cone bending and two digital readouts are standard; NC control, overhead crane and side supports are available for larger diameters.
